evidenceNotes: The three initial shards shared a timestamp; per-case artifacts survived. The aggregate was rebuilt by rescore-photo-exports.mjs, independently rendering all exported geometry against the saved source masks. Original summary preserved as results-before-rescore.json; unavailable whole-run timings are null. New shard paths are unique.

The later supported-count selection change affects only white-birds and bibel-star-curved in the recorded coarse candidates. Targeted retries still fail. All other primary outcomes describe the initial full run rather than an invented full rerun.
Accepted is a numerical criterion; visual inspection still finds false seams in some accepted results. Crop proposals and presumed motif structure are not ground-truth cutting paths.
Runtime reflects the final port. Each benchmark results.json retains its own runtime/source hashes; targeted diagnostics are not silently substituted into the 11/31 score.

Mapped crop runs retain locatorStatus=needs_review. Their older aggregate cropStatus and generic source method came from the visual-annotation harness; corrected report display prioritizes locatorStatus. Future override runs record that status, the override file hash and provenance explicitly. Coordinates and fitting results were not changed.
